mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan_maturity_overdue WHERE loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId})

SELECT (SELECT last.applied_base_rate FROM repayment_schedule last WHERE last.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} ORDER BY last.installment_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS applied_base_rate, (SELECT last.applied_additional_rate FROM repayment_schedule last WHERE last.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} ORDER BY last.installment_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS applied_additional_rate, COALESCE(SUM(rs.scheduled_interest - rs.paid_interest), 0) AS carried_interest, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(idc.delinquency_charge - idc.paid_delinquency_charge), 0) FROM installment_delinquency_charge idc JOIN repayment_schedule charged ON charged.repayment_schedule_id = idc.repayment_schedule_id WHERE charged.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} AND charged.repayment_schedule_status_id = #{overdue}) AS carried_delinquency_charge FROM repayment_schedule rs WHERE rs.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} AND rs.repayment_schedule_status_id = #{overdue}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_maturity_overdue (loan_account_id, converted_date, applied_base_rate, applied_additional_rate, carried_interest, carried_delinquency_charge) VALUES (#{loanAccountId}, #{convertedDate}, #{carryOver.appliedBaseRate}, #{carryOver.appliedAdditionalRate}, #{carryOver.carriedInterest}, #{carryOver.carriedDelinquencyCharge})
